local function createToggle(name, flag, title, description)
	local toggle = Tabs.Main:CreateToggle(name, {
		Title = title,
		Description = description,
		Default = false
	})
	toggle:OnChanged(function(value)
		autoFlags[flag] = value
	end)
end

createToggle("AutoDominusPet", "DominusPet", "Auto Spin Dominus Pet", "Automatically spins for Dominus Pet")
